title: Innocent Red: The Reincarnated God of Destruction Wants a Normal High School Life
description:
The Crimson God of Destruction, who once ruled with an iron fist, is defeated. Now... Sanada Tatsuki, the former Crimson God, is reincarnated in Japan and lives a quiet, peaceful life.

But one day, after starting high school, his peaceful days come to an end when Kozuka Hikari—a beautiful girl from another world—comes for his soul.

With the help of the mysterious woman El, the battle to protect his everyday life begins!!

His childhood friend, Sora, also makes an appearance!!
author: Watarai Kou
